_comment: Hand-verified resolutions of BR-TaxQA-R v1.1 reference file names that the automatic matcher (prefix + number + date against original/) cannot resolve, or resolves wrongly. Keys are the v1.1 'file' values. document_id null means the cited act is not in the v2.0 corpus. See docs/20260927_*_dataset_v2_format_and_reference_fixes.md.

'citation' is parsed by the same parser. Used only where the source text cannot be parsed as written; every entry gives the source wording and the reason.
